s: Set of report IDs with at least one ViewReport event; reports not in it are unused.
Count events per report for the most viewed.
Before retiring: impact analysis in the Service, subscriptions, dashboard tiles, paginated reports and Analyze in Excel on the model, owner contact, read-only period.

code.title: Unused and most-viewed reports
src: count = collections.Counter(v['ReportId'] for v in views if v['Activity'] == 'ViewReport')
unused = [r['name'] for r in reports if r['id'] not in count]
print('most viewed:', next(r['name'] for r in reports if r['id'] == top_id), top_n)

gov-monitor-0.verify: Script run locally against the mock files; counts match the build's computed values.

s: Pick signals that lead to an action: failed refreshes, duration trend, capacity peak and throttling, certified share of views, unowned items, retirement candidates, data-quality failures, open incidents.
Give each a threshold and an owner; leave out anything nobody would act on.
gov-monitor-1.check: ≤ 8 actionable signals, each with threshold and owner.

s: Day 0: impact analysis, subscriptions, tiles, Excel/paginated dependencies; identify owner.
Day 1: notify owner and viewers of the last 90 days with the replacement and dates.
Day 7: banner on the report; move subscriptions and tiles.
Day 45: archive (export PBIP to the archive repo), remove from apps.
Day 90: delete. Stop at any step if a dependency or objection appears.
gov-monitor-2.check: Staged retirement with notice, read-only, archive and delete, and explicit stop conditions.
